decision.observation: At 5:20 p.m. Saturday, the farmer is at the paved junction west of Pelican Town; a cobblestone branch runs southeast from the right side.
decision.hypothesis: Following the southeast branch should reach the fountain square, from which the southern road leads toward the beach.
decision.memory: Willy invited the farmer to the southeast beach. The Fish Shop's posted closing time is 5:00 p.m., but Willy may still be outdoors. From the fountain square, continue south to the east–west road, then go east across the river before turning south; avoid the wooded area directly south of town.
